verses.kjv: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
verses.modern: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.

verses.kjv: And he said, The LORD will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn, and the top of Carmel shall wither.
verses.modern: He said: "The LORD will roar from Zion, and lift up His voice from Jerusalem. The pastures of the shepherds will mourn, and the top of Carmel will wither."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron:
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away its punishment. Because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron,

verses.kjv: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, which shall devour the palaces of Ben-hadad.
verses.modern: I will send a fire on the house of Hazael, and it will devour the palaces of Ben-hadad.

verses.kjv: I will break also the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven, and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden: and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: I will also break the bar of Damascus. I will cut off the people who live in the plain of Aven, and the one who holds the sceptre from the house of Eden. The people of Syria will go into captivity to Kir," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Gaza, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they carried away captive the whole captivity, to deliver them up to Edom:
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "For three transgressions of Gaza, and for four, I will not turn away its punishment. Because they carried away the whole population as captives, to deliver them up to Edom,

verses.kjv: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, which shall devour the palaces thereof:
verses.modern: I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, and it will devour its palaces.

verses.kjv: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon, and I will turn mine hand against Ekron: and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: I will cut off the people who live in Ashdod, and the one who holds the sceptre from Ashkelon. I will turn My hand against Ekron, and the remnant of the Philistines will perish," says the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Tyrus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant:
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "For three transgressions of Tyrus, and for four, I will not turn away its punishment. Because they delivered up the whole population of captives to Edom, and did not remember the brotherly covenant,

verses.kjv: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyrus, which shall devour the palaces thereof.
verses.modern: I will send a fire on the wall of Tyrus, and it will devour its palaces."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever:
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away its punishment. Because He pursued His brother with the sword and cast off all pity. His anger tore on without end, and He kept His wrath forever.

verses.kjv: But I will send a fire upon Teman, which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.
verses.modern: I will send a fire on Teman, and it will devour the palaces of Bozrah."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border:
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away its punishment. Because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border,

verses.kjv: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind:
verses.modern: I will kindle a fire on the wall of Rabbah, and it will devour its palaces, with shouting on the day of battle, with a tempest on the day of the whirlwind.

verses.kjv: And their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Their king will go into captivity, He and His princes together," says the LORD.

chapters.summary: The LORD roars from Zion and pronounces judgment on the nations surrounding Israel: Damascus, Gaza, Tyre, and Edom. For three transgressions and for four, He will not turn away their punishment — because of their cruelties in war, their slave trading, and their unrelenting rage.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime:
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away its punishment. Because He burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime,

verses.kjv: But I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kirioth: and Moab shall die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet:
verses.modern: I will send a fire on Moab, and it will devour the palaces of Kirioth. Moab will die in the midst of an uproar, with shouting and with the sound of the trumpet.

verses.kjv: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: I will cut off the judge from her midst, and kill all her princes with Him," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have despised the law of the LORD, and have not kept his commandments, and their lies caused them to err, after the which their fathers have walked:
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away its punishment. Because they have despised the law of the LORD and have not kept His commandments, and their lies caused them to err — the lies their fathers walked after —

verses.kjv: But I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.
verses.modern: I will send a fire on Judah, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Israel, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they sold the righteous for silver, and the poor for a pair of shoes;
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "For three transgressions of Israel, and for four, I will not turn away its punishment. Because they sold the righteous for silver, and the poor for a pair of shoes.

verses.kjv: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek: and a man and his father will go in unto the same maid, to profane my holy name:
verses.modern: They pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek. A man and his father go in to the same young woman, to profane My holy name.

verses.kjv: And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar, and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god.
verses.modern: They lay themselves down on clothes taken in pledge beside every altar, and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god.

verses.kjv: Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.
verses.modern: Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and who was strong as the oaks. I destroyed His fruit from above, and His roots from beneath.

verses.kjv: Also I brought you up from the land of Egypt, and led you forty years through the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
verses.modern: I also brought You up from the land of Egypt, and led You forty years through the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.

verses.kjv: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazarites. Is it not even thus, O ye children of Israel? saith the LORD.
verses.modern: I raised up some of Your sons to be prophets, and some of Your young men to be Nazarites. Is it not so, You children of Israel?" says the LORD.

verses.kjv: But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink; and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.
verses.modern: "But You gave the Nazarites wine to drink, and commanded the prophets, saying, 'Do not prophesy.'

verses.kjv: Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves.
verses.modern: I am pressed down under You, as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves.

verses.kjv: Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not strengthen his force, neither shall the mighty deliver himself:
verses.modern: Therefore flight will fail the swift, the strong will not gather His strength, and the mighty will not deliver Himself.

verses.kjv: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself: neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself.
verses.modern: The one who handles the bow will not stand his ground. The swift of foot will not deliver Himself, and the one who rides the horse will not deliver himself.

verses.kjv: And he that is courageous among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: The one who is courageous among the mighty will flee away naked on that day," says the LORD.

chapters.summary: The LORD continues His judgments against Moab and then turns to Judah and Israel. Israel is condemned for selling the righteous for silver and the poor for a pair of shoes, for oppressing the afflicted, and for profaning the LORD's holy name. God reminds them He brought them out of Egypt and raised up prophets among them — yet they silenced the prophets and corrupted the Nazarites.

verses.kjv: Hear this word that the LORD hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.modern: Hear this word that the LORD has spoken against You, children of Israel — against the whole family I brought up from the land of Egypt — saying:

verses.kjv: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.
verses.modern: "You only have I known of all the families of the earth — therefore I will punish You for all Your iniquities."

verses.kjv: Can two walk together, except they be agreed?
verses.modern: Can two walk together unless they be agreed?

verses.kjv: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?
verses.modern: Will a lion roar in the forest when He has no prey? Will a young lion cry out from His den if He has taken nothing?

verses.kjv: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, where no gin is for him? shall one take up a snare from the earth, and have taken nothing at all?
verses.modern: Can a bird fall into a snare on the ground where no trap is set for Him? Will a snare spring up from the ground when it has caught nothing at all?

verses.kjv: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, and the LORD hath not done it?
verses.modern: Will a trumpet be blown in a city, and the people not be afraid? Will there be evil in a city, and the LORD has not done it?

verses.kjv: Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.
verses.modern: Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, but He reveals His secret to His servants the prophets.

verses.kjv: The lion hath roared, who will not fear? the Lord GOD hath spoken, who can but prophesy?
verses.modern: The lion has roared — who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken — who can but prophesy?

verses.kjv: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold the great tumults in the midst thereof, and the oppressed in the midst thereof.
verses.modern: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say: "Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria. See the great tumults within her, and the oppressed in her midst."

verses.kjv: For they know not to do right, saith the LORD, who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.
verses.modern: "For they do not know how to do right," says the LORD, "they who store up violence and robbery in their palaces."

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; An adversary there shall be even round about the land; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee, and thy palaces shall be spoiled.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: "An adversary will be even round about the land. He will bring down Your strength from You, and Your palaces will be plundered."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; As the shepherd taketh out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear; so shall the children of Israel be taken out that dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed, and in Damascus in a couch.
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says: "As the shepherd takes out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, so will the children of Israel be taken out — those who dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed, and in Damascus on a couch."

verses.kjv: Hear ye, and testify in the house of Jacob, saith the Lord GOD, the God of hosts,
verses.modern: "Hear and testify in the house of Jacob," says the Lord GOD, the God of hosts,

verses.kjv: That in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him I will also visit the altars of Beth-el: and the horns of the altar shall be cut off, and fall to the ground.
verses.modern: "that on the day I visit the transgressions of Israel on Him, I will also visit the altars of Bethel. The horns of the altar will be cut off and fall to the ground.

verses.kjv: And I will smite the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: I will strike the winter house along with the summer house. The houses of ivory will perish, and the great houses will come to an end," says the LORD.

chapters.summary: "You only have I known of all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities." The LORD does nothing without revealing His secret to His servants the prophets. Israel's enemies will surround the land, pull down her strongholds, and plunder her palaces — the altars of Bethel will be torn down.

verses.kjv: Hear this word, ye kine of Bashan, that are in the mountain of Samaria, which oppress the poor, which crush the needy, which say to their masters, Bring, and let us drink.
verses.modern: Hear this word, You kine of Bashan on the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor and crush the needy, who say to their masters, "Bring, and let us drink."

verses.kjv: The Lord GOD hath sworn by his holiness, that, lo, the days shall come upon you, that he will take you away with hooks, and your posterity with fishhooks.
verses.modern: The Lord GOD has sworn by His holiness that the days will come on You when He will take You away with hooks, and Your posterity with fishhooks.

verses.kjv: And ye shall go out at the breaches, every cow at that which is before her; and ye shall cast them into the palace, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: You will go out through the breaches in the wall, each cow straight before her, and You will be cast into the palace," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Come to Beth-el, and transgress; at Gilgal multiply transgression; and bring your sacrifices every morning, and your tithes after three years:
verses.modern: "Come to Bethel — and transgress! At Gilgal — multiply transgression! Bring Your sacrifices every morning, and Your tithes every three years.

verses.kjv: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, and proclaim and publish the free offerings: for this liketh you, O ye children of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: Offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, and proclaim and publish the freewill offerings — for so You love to do, children of Israel," says the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: "I also have given You cleanness of teeth in all Your cities, and want of bread in all Your places. Yet You have not returned to Me," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: And also I have withholden the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest: and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.
verses.modern: "I also withheld the rain from You, when there were yet three months to the harvest. I caused it to rain on one city, and caused it not to rain on another. One piece of ground was rained upon, and the piece on which it did not rain withered.

verses.kjv: So two or three cities wandered unto one city, to drink water; but they were not satisfied: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: So two or three cities wandered to one city to drink water, but they were not satisfied. Yet You have not returned to Me," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew: when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased, the palmerworm devoured them: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: "I have struck You with blasting and mildew. When Your gardens and Your vineyards and Your fig trees and Your olive trees increased, the palmerworm devoured them. Yet You have not returned to Me," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: your young men have I slain with the sword, and have taken away your horses; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: "I have sent among You the pestilence, after the manner of Egypt. Your young men I have slain with the sword, and have taken away Your horses. I have made the stench of Your camps come up into Your nostrils. Yet You have not returned to Me," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: I have overthrown some of you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: "I have overthrown some of You, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah. You were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning. Yet You have not returned to Me," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: and because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.
verses.modern: "Therefore this is what I will do to You, Israel. And because I will do this to You — prepare to meet Your God, Israel."

verses.kjv: For, lo, he that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth unto man what is his thought, that maketh the morning darkness, and treadeth upon the high places of the earth, The LORD, The God of hosts, is his name.
verses.modern: For He who forms the mountains, and creates the wind, and declares to man what is His thought; who makes the morning darkness, and treads on the high places of the earth — the LORD, the God of hosts, is His name.

chapters.summary: The LORD rebukes the wealthy women of Samaria — the "kine of Bashan" — who oppress the poor and crush the needy. He sent famine, drought, blight, pestilence, and overthrow like Sodom — yet they did not return to Him. "Therefore prepare to meet your God, O Israel."

verses.kjv: Hear ye this word which I take up against you, even a lamentation, O house of Israel.
verses.modern: Hear this word that I take up against You — a lamentation, house of Israel:

verses.kjv: The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is forsaken upon her land; there is none to raise her up.
verses.modern: "The virgin of Israel is fallen — she will rise no more. She is forsaken on her land; there is none to raise her up."

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; The city that went out by a thousand shall leave an hundred, and that which went forth by an hundred shall leave ten, to the house of Israel.
verses.modern: For this is what the Lord GOD says to the house of Israel: "The city that goes out by a thousand will have a hundred left, and the one that goes out by a hundred will have ten left."

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall live:
verses.modern: For this is what the LORD says to the house of Israel: "Seek Me, and You shall live.

verses.kjv: But seek not Beth-el, nor enter into Gilgal, and pass not to Beer-sheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Beth-el shall come to nought.
verses.modern: But do not seek Bethel; do not enter into Gilgal; do not pass to Beersheba. For Gilgal will surely go into captivity, and Bethel will come to nothing."

verses.kjv: Seek the LORD, and ye shall live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and devour it, and there be none to quench it in Beth-el.
verses.modern: Seek the LORD, and You shall live — or He will break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and devour it, and there will be no one to quench it in Bethel.

verses.kjv: Ye who turn judgment to wormwood, and leave off righteousness in the earth,
verses.modern: You who turn judgment into wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth —

verses.kjv: Seek him that maketh the seven stars and Orion, and turneth the shadow of death into the morning, and maketh the day dark with night: that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The LORD is his name:
verses.modern: seek Him who made the seven stars and Orion; who turns the shadow of death into the morning, and makes the day dark with night; who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the face of the earth — the LORD is His name —

verses.kjv: That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong, so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress.
verses.modern: who strengthens the spoiled against the strong, so that the spoiled comes against the fortress.

verses.kjv: They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.
verses.modern: They hate the one who rebukes in the gate, and they abhor the one who speaks uprightly.

verses.kjv: Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor, and ye take from him burdens of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted pleasant vineyards, but ye shall not drink wine of them.
verses.modern: Therefore, because You tread on the poor and take from Him burdens of wheat, You have built houses of hewn stone, but You will not dwell in them. You have planted pleasant vineyards, but You will not drink their wine.

verses.kjv: For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right.
verses.modern: For I know Your many transgressions and Your mighty sins. You afflict the just, You take a bribe, and You turn aside the poor in the gate from their right.

verses.kjv: Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in that time; for it is an evil time.
verses.modern: Therefore the prudent will keep silent in that time, for it is an evil time.

verses.kjv: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live: and so the LORD, the God of hosts, shall be with you, as ye have spoken.
verses.modern: Seek good, and not evil, that You may live. And so the LORD, the God of hosts, will be with You, as You have said.

verses.kjv: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish judgment in the gate: it may be that the LORD God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.
verses.modern: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish judgment in the gate. It may be that the LORD God of hosts will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.

verses.kjv: Therefore the LORD, the God of hosts, the Lord, saith thus; Wailing shall be in all streets; and they shall say in all the highways, Alas! alas! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning, and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD, the God of hosts, the Lord, says: "Wailing will be in all streets, and in all the highways they will say, 'Alas! Alas!' They will call the husbandman to mourning, and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing.

verses.kjv: And in all vineyards shall be wailing: for I will pass through thee, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: And in all vineyards there will be wailing — for I will pass through Your midst," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you that desire the day of the LORD! to what end is it for you? the day of the LORD is darkness, and not light.
verses.modern: Woe to You who desire the day of the LORD! To what end is it for You? The day of the LORD is darkness, and not light.

verses.kjv: As if a man did flee from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house, and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him.
verses.modern: It will be as if a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house and leaned His hand on the wall, and a serpent bit Him.

verses.kjv: Shall not the day of the LORD be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?
verses.modern: Will not the day of the LORD be darkness, and not light? Very dark, and no brightness in it?

verses.kjv: I hate, I despise your feast days, and I will not smell in your solemn assemblies.
verses.modern: "I hate, I despise Your feast days, and I will not smell in Your solemn assemblies.

verses.kjv: Though ye offer me burnt offerings and your meat offerings, I will not accept them: neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts.
verses.modern: Though You offer Me burnt offerings and Your meat offerings, I will not accept them. I will not regard the peace offerings of Your fat beasts.

verses.kjv: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols.
verses.modern: Take away from Me the noise of Your songs, for I will not hear the melody of Your viols.

verses.kjv: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.
verses.modern: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.

verses.kjv: Have ye offered unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?
verses.modern: Did You offer Me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, house of Israel?

verses.kjv: But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.
verses.modern: But You have borne the tabernacle of Your Moloch and Chiun Your images — the star of Your god — which You made for yourselves.

verses.kjv: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, saith the LORD, whose name is The God of hosts.
verses.modern: Therefore I will cause You to go into captivity beyond Damascus," says the LORD, whose name is the God of hosts.

chapters.summary: Amos takes up a lament: "The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more rise." The LORD calls them to seek Him and live — to seek good and not evil, to establish justice in the gate. He despises their feast days and will not accept their offerings. "Let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream."

verses.kjv: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, which are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel came!
verses.modern: Woe to those who are at ease in Zion, and who trust in the mountain of Samaria — those who are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel comes!

verses.kjv: Pass ye unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great: then go down to Gath of the Philistines: be they better than these kingdoms? or their border greater than your border?
verses.modern: Pass over to Calneh and see, and from there go to Hamath the great. Then go down to Gath of the Philistines. Are they better than these kingdoms? Is their border greater than your border?

verses.kjv: Ye that put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;
verses.modern: You who put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;

verses.kjv: That lie upon beds of ivory, and stretch themselves upon their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the stall;
verses.modern: who lie on beds of ivory, and stretch themselves on their couches; who eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the stall;

verses.kjv: That chant to the sound of the viol, and invent to themselves instruments of musick, like David;
verses.modern: who chant to the sound of the viol, and invent for themselves instruments of musick, like David;

verses.kjv: That drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief ointments: but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.
verses.modern: who drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief ointments — but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.

verses.kjv: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.
verses.modern: Therefore they will now go captive with the first who go captive, and the banquet of those who stretched themselves will be removed.

verses.kjv: The Lord GOD hath sworn by himself, saith the LORD the God of hosts, I abhor the excellency of Jacob, and hate his palaces: therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein.
verses.modern: The Lord GOD has sworn by Himself, says the LORD the God of hosts: "I abhor the excellency of Jacob, and hate his palaces. Therefore I will deliver up the city and all that is in it."

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.
verses.modern: And it will come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they will die.

verses.kjv: And a man's uncle shall take him up, and he that burneth him, to bring out the bones out of the house, and shall say unto him that is by the sides of the house, Is there yet any with thee? and he shall say, No. Then shall he say, Hold thy tongue: for we may not make mention of the name of the LORD.
verses.modern: And a man's uncle will take him up, and the one who burns him, to bring the bones out of the house. He will say to the one in the inner part of the house, "Is there yet any with You?" and He will say, "No." Then He will say, "Hold Your tongue, for we may not make mention of the name of the LORD."

verses.kjv: For, behold, the LORD commandeth, and he will smite the great house with breaches, and the little house with clefts.
verses.modern: For the LORD commands, and He will strike the great house with breaches, and the little house with clefts.

verses.kjv: Shall horses run upon the rock? will one plow there with oxen? for ye have turned judgment into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock:
verses.modern: Will horses run on the rock? Will one plow there with oxen? Yet You have turned judgment into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock —

verses.kjv: Ye which rejoice in a thing of nought, which say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?
verses.modern: you who rejoice in a thing of nothing, who say, "Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?"

verses.kjv: But, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel, saith the LORD the God of hosts; and they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hemath unto the river of the wilderness.
verses.modern: "For I will raise up against You a nation, house of Israel," says the LORD the God of hosts, "and they will afflict You from the entrance of Hamath to the river of the wilderness."

chapters.summary: Woe to the complacent in Zion and the overconfident in Samaria — they lie on beds of ivory, feast on lambs and calves, sing idle songs, and drink wine by the bowlful, yet they grieve not over the ruin of Joseph. Therefore they will go into captivity first among the captives, and the revelry of the loungers will cease.

verses.kjv: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me; and, behold, he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and, lo, it was the latter growth after the king's mowings.
verses.modern: This is what the Lord GOD showed me: He was forming grasshoppers at the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth — the latter growth after the king's mowings.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land, then I said, O Lord GOD, forgive, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
verses.modern: When they had made an end of eating the grass of the land, then I said, "Lord GOD, forgive, I beseech You! By whom will Jacob arise? For he is small."

verses.kjv: The LORD repented for this: It shall not be, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: The LORD repented concerning this. "It will not be," said the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me: and, behold, the Lord GOD called to contend by fire, and it devoured the great deep, and did eat up a part.
verses.modern: This is what the Lord GOD showed me: the Lord GOD called to contend by fire, and it devoured the great deep, and consumed a part.

verses.kjv: Then said I, O Lord GOD, cease, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
verses.modern: Then I said, "Lord GOD, cease, I beseech You! By whom will Jacob arise? For he is small."

verses.kjv: The LORD repented for this: This also shall not be, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: The LORD repented concerning this. "This also will not be," said the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: Thus he shewed me: and, behold, the LORD stood upon a wall made by a plumbline, with a plumbline in his hand.
verses.modern: This is what He showed me: the Lord stood on a wall made by a plumbline, with a plumbline in His hand.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A plumbline. Then said the LORD, Behold, I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Israel: I will not again pass by them any more:
verses.modern: The LORD said to me, "Amos, what do you see?" And I said, "A plumbline." Then the Lord said, "I will set a plumbline in the midst of My people Israel. I will not again pass by them any more.

verses.kjv: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.
verses.modern: The high places of Isaac will be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Israel will be laid waste. I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword."

verses.kjv: Then Amaziah the priest of Beth-el sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel: the land is not able to bear all his words.
verses.modern: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, "Amos has conspired against you in the midst of the house of Israel. The land is not able to bear all his words.

verses.kjv: For thus Amos saith, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.
verses.modern: For this is what Amos says: 'Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel will surely be led away captive out of their own land.' "

verses.kjv: Also Amaziah said unto Amos, O thou seer, go, flee thee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:
verses.modern: Amaziah also said to Amos, "Seer, go! Flee away to the land of Judah; there eat bread, and prophesy there.

verses.kjv: But prophesy not again any more at Beth-el: for it is the king's chapel, and it is the king's court.
verses.modern: But do not prophesy any more at Bethel, for it is the king's chapel and the king's court."

verses.kjv: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit:
verses.modern: Then Amos answered, and said to Amaziah, "I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son. I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit.

verses.kjv: And the LORD took me as I followed the flock, and the LORD said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Israel.
verses.modern: The LORD took me as I followed the flock, and the LORD said to me, 'Go, prophesy to My people Israel.'

verses.kjv: Now therefore hear thou the word of the LORD: Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, and drop not thy word against the house of Isaac.
verses.modern: Now therefore hear the word of the LORD. You say, 'Do not prophesy against Israel, and drop not Your word against the house of Isaac.'

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city, and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, and thy land shall be divided by line; and thou shalt die in a polluted land: and Israel shall surely go into captivity forth of his land.
verses.modern: Therefore this is what the LORD says: 'Your wife will be a harlot in the city, and Your sons and Your daughters will fall by the sword. Your land will be divided by line, and You Yourself will die in a polluted land. And Israel will surely go into captivity, away from His land.' "

chapters.summary: The LORD shows Amos three visions: a plague of grasshoppers and a fire — both of which He relents from after Amos intercedes — and a plumb line set against Israel, which He will not pass by again. Amaziah the priest of Bethel opposes Amos, but Amos replies that the LORD took him from following the flock and sent him to prophesy against Israel.

verses.kjv: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me: and behold a basket of summer fruit.
verses.modern: This is what the Lord GOD showed me: a basket of summer fruit.

verses.kjv: And he said, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then said the LORD unto me, The end is come upon my people of Israel; I will not again pass by them any more.
verses.modern: And He said, "Amos, what do you see?" And I said, "A basket of summer fruit." Then the LORD said to me, "The end is come on My people Israel. I will not again pass by them any more.

verses.kjv: And the songs of the temple shall be howlings in that day, saith the Lord GOD: there shall be many dead bodies in every place; they shall cast them forth with silence.
verses.modern: The songs of the temple will be howlings on that day," says the Lord GOD. "There will be many dead bodies in every place; they will cast them forth in silence."

verses.kjv: Hear this, O ye that swallow up the needy, even to make the poor of the land to fail,
verses.modern: Hear this, You who swallow up the needy, even to make the poor of the land to fail —

verses.kjv: Saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances by deceit?
verses.modern: saying, "When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? And the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat? — making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances by deceit,

verses.kjv: That we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes; yea, and sell the refuse of the wheat?
verses.modern: that we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes — and sell the refuse of the wheat?"

verses.kjv: The LORD hath sworn by the excellency of Jacob, Surely I will never forget any of their works.
verses.modern: The LORD has sworn by the excellency of Jacob: "Surely I will never forget any of their works.

verses.kjv: Shall not the land tremble for this, and every one mourn that dwelleth therein? and it shall rise up wholly as a flood; and it shall be cast out and drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.
verses.modern: Will not the land tremble for this, and every one who dwells in it mourn? It will rise up wholly as a flood; it will be cast out and drowned, as by the flood of Egypt."

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord GOD, that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day:
verses.modern: "And it will come to pass on that day," says the Lord GOD, "that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day.

verses.kjv: And I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins, and baldness upon every head; and I will make it as the mourning of an only son, and the end thereof as a bitter day.
verses.modern: I will turn Your feasts into mourning, and all Your songs into lamentation. I will bring up sackcloth on all loins, and baldness on every head. I will make it as the mourning of an only son, and the end of it as a bitter day.

verses.kjv: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord GOD, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the LORD:
verses.modern: "The days are coming," says the Lord GOD, "when I will send a famine in the land — not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east, they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the LORD, and shall not find it.
verses.modern: They will wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east. They will run to and fro to seek the word of the LORD, and will not find it.

verses.kjv: In that day shall the fair virgins and young men faint for thirst.
verses.modern: On that day the fair virgins and young men will faint for thirst.

verses.kjv: They that swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, Thy god, O Dan, liveth; and, The manner of Beer-sheba liveth; even they shall fall, and never rise up again.
verses.modern: Those who swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, 'As Your god lives, Dan,' and, 'As the manner of Beersheba lives' — they will fall, and never rise up again."

chapters.summary: The LORD shows Amos a basket of summer fruit — the end has come for Israel. He condemns those who trample the needy, who cannot wait for the Sabbath to end so they can cheat with dishonest scales. The LORD will send a famine — not of bread or water, but of hearing the words of the LORD — and they will search for His word but not find it.

verses.kjv: I saw the LORD standing upon the altar: and he said, Smite the lintel of the door, that the posts may shake: and cut them in the head, all of them; and I will slay the last of them with the sword: he that fleeth of them shall not flee away, and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered.
verses.modern: I saw the Lord standing on the altar, and He said: "Smite the lintel of the door, that the posts may shake. Cut them on the head, all of them — and I will slay the last of them with the sword. He who flees of them will not flee away, and he who escapes of them will not be delivered.

verses.kjv: Though they dig into hell, thence shall mine hand take them; though they climb up to heaven, thence will I bring them down:
verses.modern: Though they dig into hell, from there shall My hand take them. Though they climb up to heaven, from there will I bring them down.

verses.kjv: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out thence; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea, thence will I command the serpent, and he shall bite them:
verses.modern: Though they hide themselves on the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out from there. Though they be hidden from My sight in the bottom of the sea, from there will I command the serpent, and he will bite them.

verses.kjv: And though they go into captivity before their enemies, thence will I command the sword, and it shall slay them: and I will set mine eyes upon them for evil, and not for good.
verses.modern: And though they go into captivity before their enemies, from there will I command the sword, and it will slay them. I will set My eyes on them for evil, and not for good."

verses.kjv: And the Lord GOD of hosts is he that toucheth the land, and it shall melt, and all that dwell therein shall mourn: and it shall rise up wholly like a flood; and shall be drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.
verses.modern: The Lord GOD of hosts is He who touches the land, and it melts, and all who dwell in it mourn. It rises up wholly like a flood, and is drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.

verses.kjv: It is he that buildeth his stories in the heaven, and hath founded his troop in the earth; he that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The LORD is his name.
verses.modern: It is He who builds his stories in the heaven, and has founded His troop on the earth. He calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the face of the earth — the LORD is His name.

verses.kjv: Are ye not as children of the Ethiopians unto me, O children of Israel? saith the LORD. Have not I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt? and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?
verses.modern: "Are You not as children of the Ethiopians to Me, children of Israel?" says the LORD. "Have I not brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt? And the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?

verses.kjv: Behold, the eyes of the Lord GOD are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth; saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: The eyes of the Lord GOD are on the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth — saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: For, lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all nations, like as corn is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.
verses.modern: "For I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all nations, as corn is sifted in a sieve, yet not the least grain will fall on the earth.

verses.kjv: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us.
verses.modern: All the sinners of My people will die by the sword — those who say, 'The evil will not overtake nor prevent us.'

verses.kjv: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old:
verses.modern: "In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof. I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old,

verses.kjv: That they may possess the remnant of Edom, and of all the heathen, which are called by my name, saith the LORD that doeth this.
verses.modern: that they may possess the remnant of Edom, and of all the heathen who are called by My name," says the LORD Who does this.

verses.kjv: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.
verses.modern: "The days are coming," says the LORD, "when the plowman will overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes the one who sows seed. The mountains will drop sweet wine, and all the hills will melt.

verses.kjv: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.modern: I will bring again the captivity of My people Israel, and they will build the waste cities and dwell in them. They will plant vineyards and drink the wine of them. They will also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

verses.kjv: And I will plant them upon their land, and they shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them, saith the LORD thy God.
verses.modern: I will plant them on their land, and they will no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them," says the LORD Your God.

chapters.summary: Amos sees the Lord standing beside the altar, commanding destruction — none will escape, whether they dig into hell or climb to heaven. Yet the LORD will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob. In that day He will raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and Israel will be planted on their own land and never again be pulled up.
